d:
This has to be the most underrated hillock in Ghatshila! Join me on Travel Vlog EP 03 as I take on the climb to the top of Chitrakoot Hillock. I was completely alone at this quiet, ancient spot and discovered a peaceful, beautiful Shiva Temple nestled among stunning natural rock formations. If you’re planning a weekend trip to Ghatshila or looking for unique, uncrowded spots in Jharkhand, this must-see destination is for you!
